Radio Comparison

Tecsun PL-330 vs ZHIWHIS ZWS-A330

The Tecsun PL-330 and ZHIWHIS ZWS-A330 side by side: shortwave coverage, SSB, synchronous AM, power and size, from manufacturer and retailer specifications.

Key differences

  • The Tecsun PL-330 has synchronous AM; it is not listed for the ZHIWHIS ZWS-A330.
  • Shortwave coverage: Tecsun PL-330 1711–29999 kHz vs ZHIWHIS ZWS-A330 2.3–30 MHz.
  • Only the ZHIWHIS ZWS-A330 lists the aircraft band.
  • Power: Tecsun PL-330 uses BL-5C 1000 mAh Li-ion, USB-C charging; ZHIWHIS ZWS-A330 uses BL-5C Li-ion, USB-C charging.
  • Antenna input: Tecsun PL-330 has external antenna input (3.5 mm); ZHIWHIS ZWS-A330 has external antenna jack (3.5 mm).

Which should you buy?

Choose the Tecsun PL-330 if you want full SSB and sync AM in a shirt-pocket size.

Choose the ZHIWHIS ZWS-A330 if you want VHF/UHF, CB and microSD recording as well as shortwave, you also want the aircraft band, you want a radio we have tested hands-on.
